dogecoin.text: I guess everyone was selling out at the same time, was just able to sell 80 shares. Keeping some shares to see if it improves in the future, but I don’t think we will ever get #DogeCoinTo1Dollar #dogecoin

Bought some (100 shares) of #dogecoin last Saturday because I was convinced @elonmusk would get #DogeCoinTo1Dollar during his stint as #SNL host. It’s dropped 20 cents since midnight yesterday, and @RobinhoodApp won’t let me sell any of the shares 🙄
